Israel's Bank Leumi partners with Galaxy Digital for BTC, ETH, SOL trading –
Link
Bank Leumi, Israel's largest bank, announced a partnership with Galaxy Digital to offer retail crypto trading for BTC, ETH, and SOL via its Leumi Trade app.

Solana advances SIMD-0553 fee overhaul proposal –
Link
A Solana proposal, SIMD-0553, that would raise fees on resource-intensive transactions while lowering costs for simple ones is progressing.
• Projected daily SOL burn: roughly 12–14x higher
• Current estimate: ≈648 SOL/day
• Proposed range: 7,500–9,000 SOL/day
Matters because: Higher structural burn could modestly tighten SOL supply growth and support long-term token economics if the proposal is adopted.

Prediction Markets Are a Bad Bet

Silicon Valley’s era-defining technologies often sit on a razor’s edge between utopian and dystopian.

The sharing economy promised communal exchange at the tap of a smart phone — or risking it all by jumping in a stranger’s car, or trusting others to deliver. (It largely ended up being more banal: convenient, smartphone-enhanced regulatory arbitrage.)

AI is giving everyone a genius at their fingertips — or creating a super-intelligence that will put us out of jobs and maybe destroy the world.

Juul was a way for cigarette addicts to get off the hard stuff and do something safer — until it became clear it was instead another gateway to addiction, creating a generation of young vape fiends.

recent_posts.text: Gavin Baker: Dario Thinks Anthropic Might be the Only Private Company Left in the World  > “Internally, Anthropic is very confident. I have been told by multiple people I trust that Dario has said that Anthropic might be the only private company in the world…

tweet.text:
Completely false.

I like Gavin's takes, but whoever he heard this from is lying so that it fits the narrative some people so desperately want you to believe. 

The same people will try to convince you Anthropic has no moat, and a sentence later that it might become so powerful it could be the only company left.

In fact, one of the things we are _most_ worried about is economic concentration of power. There is no world where the government should let any company have that much influence. We need competition and capitalism. https://darioamodei.com/essay/the-adolescence-of-technology#2-a-surprising-and-terrible-empowerment

The AI market is literally the most competetive market in the world right now - every single one of the largest companies on earth is singularly focused on getting you smarter, cheaper models. If it all works out, we'll succeed in reducing the cost of everything to the cost of energy. This is awesome, but it threatens a lot of people's old moats. They are frightened.

SEC postpones "regulation crypto" rule-making meeting, citing scheduling issues –
Link
The SEC canceled its Aug. 15 meeting to propose "Regulation Crypto," the first major crypto securities exemption framework, with no new date set. The related tokenized-stock "innovation exemption" was also delayed again amid Wall Street and White House pushback.
Matters because: This stalls two major 2026 regulatory catalysts and keeps near-term uncertainty elevated for US-listed tokenization plays.
